games.title: Orchard
games.blurb: Swipe to steer your snake around a wrapping orchard and hold to sprint. Fruit makes you longer, bombs cost a hundred, and driving your nose into the other snake scores; five hits wins the match.

games.title: Air Hockey
games.blurb: Drag your thumb across your own half to slide your mallet and knock the puck into the goal slot behind your opponent. Each phone shows the table from its own end, and seven goals takes the match.

games.title: Moonbloom
games.blurb: Lead your moth with a fingertip and hold it over a closed bud until the bud opens in your colour. Both phones can work the same bud and nothing you have grown can be taken back; eight blossoms wins the night.

games.title: Dawn Patrol
games.blurb: Drag anywhere to bank your fighter and hold the FIRE button until the guns overheat. Parachuted crates multiply your rate of fire, damage and gun count for a few seconds, while mines and flak bursts hurt whoever is nearest; five kills takes the patrol.

games.title: Chess
games.blurb: A full game of chess played across two phones, each showing the board from its own side. Tap a man then tap its square; castling, en passant, promotion and threefold repetition are all enforced, with five minutes each and three seconds a move. Practice alone against a computer set to easy, normal or hard.

games.title: Scrap War
games.blurb: Two allied tanks hold one yard against a machine army, and only the higher tally wins. Drag anywhere to drive while the turret finds, leads and fires on its own target, grab railguns, shields and stun pulses off the sand, and watch the last thirty seconds pay double.
